title: BotLens: artifact for "Measuring Users' Security and Privacy Concerns About Third-Party Community Bots on Discord" (NDSS 2027)
description:
Artifact for Kofi Ampomah and Tu Le, "Measuring Users' Security and Privacy Concerns About Third-Party Community Bots on Discord", Network and Distributed System Security (NDSS) Symposium 2027, doi:10.14722/ndss.2027.230535. NDSS'27 Artifact Evaluation badges: Available, Functional, Reproduced.

Contains the analysis pipeline, the 31-theme security and privacy taxonomy, the derived datasets behind every reported result (botlens-ndss-data.zip), and the BotLens MCP server. Start with ARTIFACT-EVALUATION.md.

Licenses: the code is released under the MIT License (LICENSE). The data in botlens-ndss-data.zip is released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (data/LICENSE). The CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license applies strictly to the annotations, labels, and dataset compilation created by the authors. The underlying data remains subject to the original creators' terms.
